Netanagri Full Episode:
PM Modi and Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi each have their own strengths and weaknesses. In 'Netanagri', the discussion began with the differences in how Rahul and Priyanka work, and eventually extended to the differences between Narendra Modi and Rahul—could they perhaps learn something from each other?
